Each term comes with its FDR, strength and the proteins that carry it, most significant first. Use two or more proteins: with one, STRING adds its 10 closest partners.

description: Explore protein-protein interactions with STRING, the database of known and predicted protein networks for over 12,000 organisms: map gene names to proteins, get interaction networks and partners with confidence scores, run functional enrichment (GO, KEGG, Reactome) and interaction enrichment on a gene list, find homologs, and link to network pictures.
